criteria.requirement: Implement jmespath.streaming.iter_search(expression,documents,*,options=None,errors="raise"). Compile/bind once before consuming first document and yield one result per consumed document without prefetching. Default returns raw standard values; collect returns (zero_based_index,QueryResult) for each success or JMESPath evaluation error using the completed result schema. Syntax errors always raise before input consumption, source/programmer errors propagate, stopping/closing iteration reads no further documents, and independent literal results remain detached. Never materialize whole streams.
